premieresThisWeek.title: 斯图尔特未能拯救宇宙
premieresThisWeek.titleEn: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
premieresThisWeek.summary: 故事聚焦《大爆炸》的漫画书老板斯图尔特·布鲁姆，他弄坏了一个谢尔顿和莱纳德制造的设备，意外导致了多元宇宙的世界末日，他必须与女友Denise、地质学家Bert和量子物理学家Barry一起去将现实复原。一路上，他们遇到了平行宇宙版本的各个《大爆炸》角色，事情进展并不顺利。
premieresThisWeek.summaryEn: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.

premieresThisWeek.title: GIGN：精英部队
premieresThisWeek.summary: 所属精英部队遭遇空前袭击，即将从第一线退下的高级军官率队展开危险任务，也因而被迫面对自己的过去。
premieresThisWeek.summaryEn: After an unprecedented attack on his unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.

upcoming.title: 我的荒糖恋爱
upcoming.summary: 一名事业心十足的检察官失忆后，搬去和声称是自己男友的拳击教练同住。这段尴尬同居会发展成真爱吗？
upcoming.summaryEn: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

upcoming.title: 聪明镇
upcoming.summary: 在一座用严苛校规将学生塑造成 “完美模样” 的小镇里，生长着一棵隐秘的血果树，枝头结满赤红果实。一名神秘黑衣少年，只把果实赠予真正 “需要” 它的人。吃下果实后，人们被长久压抑的欲望尽数觉醒 —— 它温柔地叩开人心，也悄然将这座小镇推向无可挽回的覆灭。
upcoming.summaryEn: In a town where strict rules shape students into their “best selves,” a hidden Bloodfruit Tree bears crimson fruit. A mysterious boy in black delivers these fruits only to those who truly “need” them.

upcoming.title: 杀手妈咪
